stories.title: Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits, plunging AI chipmaking giant into turmoil
stories.body: US lawmakers now want to question him over whether one of his alleged relationships was with a Chinese spy.

stories.title: US envoys meet Zelensky in Dublin after talks with Putin in Moscow
stories.body: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.

stories.title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?
stories.body: The army has taken control of most of Tigray's main towns - it is unclear if the TPLF is capable of fighting back.

stories.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
stories.body: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.

stories.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
stories.body: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.

stories.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
stories.body: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

stories.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
stories.body: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

stories.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
stories.body: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns

stories.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
stories.body: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

stories.title: Five new miniature frog species found in eastern Himalayas
stories.body: Scientists say the frogs evolved as the Himalayas rose and the Asian monsoon took shape.

stories.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
stories.body: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.

stories.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
stories.body: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.

stories.title: Search for British woman missing from Tui cruise in Atlantic called off
stories.body: The 72-year-old is believed to have gone overboard from the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.

stories.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
stories.body: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

stories.title: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive
stories.body: The 17-year-old's mum has joked that he is "grounded for life" and "never leaving the house again".

stories.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
stories.body: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

stories.title: Famed ship SS United States deliberately sunk off Florida coast to become a reef
stories.body: Activists wanted the historic liner to be turned into a museum, but it will instead become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

stories.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
stories.body: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.

stories.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
stories.body: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

stories.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued after being buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
stories.body: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

The contested nature of these signals suggests potential volatility, with outcomes contingent on sustained engagement and strategic alignment. Additionally, the resignation of Nvidia's CEO introduces uncertainty in the AI sector, a critical area for global technological and economic competition. The day's signals collectively point to a world in flux, where resilience and cautious optimism are tempered by the persistent undercurrents of systemic challenges and geopolitical fragility.
